description: Resumable tracker for finishing windowsweep to 100% feature-complete and production-ready. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on. The specification for every RW- item is remaining-work.md at the repository root; this file is the ONLY status record.

The docs site domain depends on an owner DNS row; README links switch only after a 200 probe.

resumeInstructions: 1) Read CLAUDE.md, remaining-work.md and this tracker. 2) Find the first pending sub-task (owner rows are blocked + awaitingUser: prepare, never execute). 3) Do that item or phase only, obeying the IRON rules. 4) Run the item's gates. 5) Flip the sub-task in the same commit as the work, bump lastUpdated, append a runHistory row with the SHA. 6) One commit, push to o main, quote any 'Bypassed rule violations' line.
